Accessibility statement

Drawn up on 27 October 2026

Contents

  1. Compliance status
  2. Test results
  3. Non-accessible content
  4. Preparation of this statement
  5. Feedback and contact
  6. Enforcement procedure

MABEL AGENCY is committed to making its website accessible, in accordance with article 47 of French law no. 2005-102 of 11 February 2005. This statement applies to the website accessibilitenumerique.eu.

Compliance status

The website accessibilitenumerique.eu is fully compliant with the General Accessibility Improvement Framework (RGAA), version 4.1.2.

Test results

The compliance audit carried out internally by the firm’s team shows that 100% of applicable RGAA criteria are met.

Non-accessible content

No non-compliance was found.

Preparation of this statement

Technologies used to build the website: HTML, CSS, JavaScript.

Test environment: NVDA with Firefox, JAWS with Chrome, VoiceOver with Safari (macOS and iOS), TalkBack with Chrome (Android).

Pages checked: home, services, a service page, standards, the firm, resources, contact, legal notice, accessibility statement, sitemap.

Feedback and contact

If you cannot access some content or a service, you can contact us to be directed to an accessible alternative or to obtain the content in another form: contact@accessibilitenumerique.eu.

Enforcement procedure

If you have reported an accessibility issue that prevents you from accessing content or a service and have not received a satisfactory answer, you can write to the French Défenseur des droits, contact their local delegate, or send a free letter, without a stamp, to: Défenseur des droits, Libre réponse 71120, 75342 Paris CEDEX 07, France. Outside France, you may also contact the enforcement body of your country.
